author: Mark Atwood
text: Blocked on canonical mail-client propagation. The 'five-step' / six-step mismatch in the module docstring is verbatim from canonical mail-client (email.rs, identity.rs, mailbox.rs, submission.rs, etc. — all carry the same identically-worded docstring with the same off-by-one). Fixing here alone would diverge from canonical. Needs a canonical-mail-client side bead + propagation sweep to all 8 extension-client crates (mail + 7 siblings) in one pass.
